basicAuth.notes: Server-level gate in front of the whole domain, separate from each surface's own sign-in form — omit this block entirely if the environment has none.

login.notes: Describe anything non-obvious: a pool of valid test IDs instead of one fixed login, a magic-link flow, an OTP step, etc. qa-tester reads this field to know how to fill in the login form.

mobile.notes: A mobile surface has 'platform' instead of 'appUrl'. installMode: "clean" (default — uninstall, rebuild native projects, install fresh build every run), "update" (fresh build installed over the existing app, data kept — for upgrade testing), or "installed" (no build, test whatever is on the device). A mode named in the run's brief overrides this for that run.

notes: Free-form: anything qa-tester needs to disambiguate which surface a PR touches, how to find the feature branch when the platform's PR API is unreachable, or which credential group to prefer by default.
